ail._doc: r53 AILMENTS (owner 22 Oct 12:10, Combat/BOAilments.h): the real ailments. bEnabled false = patch 20 (Burning/Shocked/Poisoned are looks only). Chances are % per hit carrying the element (+ the hero's IgniteChance/ShockChance/PoisonChance stats; a PoisonChance stat also poisons with Physical). Ignite: IgniteFrac of the fire hit over IgniteSeconds, strongest applies. Shock: ShockCoef x (lightning hit / life)^ShockPow % more damage taken, ShockMin..ShockMax (ShockEffect raises the cap to ShockMaxCap). Poison: stacks of PoisonFracPerSec of the hit per second for PoisonSeconds. Freeze: FreezeSecPerPct s per 1% of life a cold hit took, from FreezeMinSeconds, to FreezeMaxSeconds; rares x FreezeRareMult, bosses x FreezeBossMult (max FreezeBossMaxSeconds, then immune FreezeBossImmuneSeconds). -BOAilmentsOn / -BOAilmentsLegacy override.
ail._doc_ShockStackCap_r90: r90 META-BALANCE-A dp-080: stacked Shocks add up to at most this % more damage taken (absent = 60, patch 63). 75 = the 5th and later of the 8 slots count again.
ail._doc_PoisonTaken_r63h: r63h SKILLCODE (H14, #278): poison ticks are multiplied by the enemy's damage taken (curses, Hunter's Marks, War Banner, the monster's own) read at each tick, like the hit. false / -BOPoisonTakenLegacy = before.
ail._doc_MinionAil_r63h: r63h SKILLCODE (H16): a minion's hit ignites / shocks / poisons with the added chance of its summon skill (supports, lines; no base chance, no freeze/chill), owned by its hero. false / -BOMinionAilmentsLegacy = before.

skills.Name: Bare Fists
skills.Description: Strike with your bare hands. Weak, but better than nothing. Find a weapon.

skills.Name: Slash
skills.Description: Your weapon's basic attack, no mana cost. Quick cuts at the enemy in front of you, three in a row.

skills.Name: Cleave
skills.Description: Cleave through every enemy in a wide arc in front of you. Your greatsword's mana skill; Slash is its free attack.

skills.Name: Arcane Bolt
skills.Description: Your staff's basic attack, no mana cost. A fast bolt of violet arcane force that strikes the first enemy in its path.

skills.Name: Zap
skills.Description: A spell: lightning strikes the enemy from the sky, then chains to {Chains} more. Your staff's mana skill; Arcane Bolt is its free attack.

skills.Name: Ground Slam
skills.Description: Slam the ground: a shockwave bursts out in a cone in front of you, damaging every enemy it reaches.

skills.Name: Leap Slam
skills.Description: Leap through the air to the target location and crash down, damaging enemies where you land.

skills.Name: Ember Bolt
skills.Description: Hurl a ball of fire that explodes on impact, burning every enemy in the blast.

skills.Name: Frost Nova
skills.Description: Release a ring of frost around you, damaging and chilling every nearby enemy.

skills.Name: Chain Lightning
skills.Description: Lightning leaps from your hand to the enemy you aim at (or the nearest one), then chains between up to {Chains} more, a tenth less on each jump.

skills.Name: Ancestral Warrior
skills.Description: Raise a carved warrior statue that slams the ground around it whenever enemies close in. You attack faster while you stand near it.

skills.Name: Toll of Dread
skills.Description: Ring the toll: enemies in the area take Poison damage, more per Dread of their Woes, then the Woes are consumed and a Sentence ends, giving its charge.

skills.Name: Storm Whirl
skills.Description: Hold to spin in a lightning vortex toward the cursor, striking everything around you.

skills.Name: Flame Dash
skills.Description: Teleport toward the cursor, leaving a burning path. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.

skills.Name: Winter Orb
skills.Description: Hold orbs of ice that hurl icicles at nearby enemies, then shatter in a chilling blast.

skills.Name: Storm Spark
skills.Description: Throw sparks that latch onto an enemy and strike it with chaining lightning. They jump on when it dies.

skills.Name: Ember Spark
skills.Description: Throw sparks that latch onto one enemy and burn it with heavy fire blows. They jump on when it dies.

skills.Name: Rime Spark
skills.Description: Throw sparks that latch onto an enemy and strike with chaining frost that chills the pack.

skills.Name: Venom Spark
skills.Description: Throw sparks that latch onto an enemy and chain venom, stacking poison the longer they crawl.

skills.Name: Thunderfall
skills.Description: Strike three times with your weapon. The third blow calls lightning down on the enemies in front of you.

skills.Name: Glacial Shards
skills.Description: Flick shards of ice from your weapon. Each bursts on the first enemy it hits and chills nearby foes.

skills.Name: Wayward Orb
skills.Description: Loose orbs that settle over enemies, pulse on everything near the host and leap on every third pulse.

skills.Name: Living Orb
skills.Description: Become a living orb and fly between enemy groups, bursting on each. You cannot be hit while you fly.

skills.Name: Reap
skills.Description: Your scythe's basic attack, no mana cost. A wide sweep that cuts everything in front of you.

skills.Name: Death Coil
skills.Description: Your scythe's mana skill. Hurl a grave-magic coil that seeks a foe and rots everything near it.

skills.Name: Drain Life
skills.Description: Hold to tether the enemy under the cursor and rot it. The beam forks to 3 more enemies and heals you and your minions.

skills.Name: Vampire Dash
skills.Description: Turn to mist and bats and reform toward the cursor, rotting the path. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.

skills.Name: Unholy Void
skills.Description: Open a void around you that poisons enemies inside and slows them 10%. It drains you up to 0.9% life a second (your Poison resistance lowers it). Press again to close it.

skills.Name: Gravereap
skills.Description: Sweep in a wide arc. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Thralls that fight for you. 40% of its physical damage becomes Poison.

skills.Name: Soul Rend
skills.Description: Two heavy chops tear at the soul. Rent enemies take 10% more damage from your minions for 4 seconds.

skills.Name: Marrow Lance
skills.Description: Hurl a bone lance that pierces the line. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Casters that fight for you.

skills.Name: Pyre Burst
skills.Description: Set a fresh corpse near your aim ablaze. It bursts in fire, hitting every enemy around it.

skills.Name: Hammer Blow
skills.Description: Your mace's basic attack, no mana cost. A heavy blow at the enemy in front of you.

skills.Name: Holy Slash
skills.Description: A wide sweep that leaves a crescent of holy light, striking every enemy in front of you.

skills.Name: Judgement
skills.Description: Raise your weapon to the sky: bolts of holy light crash down on the target and the enemies nearest it, one after another.

skills.Name: Orbiting Hammers
skills.Description: Turn on a ring of spectral hammers that sweeps out through the enemies around you and back, smashing everything it passes. Drains mana while it spins; press again to stop.

skills.Name: Consecrated Ground
skills.Description: Hallow the ground around you. Enemies on it are hurt twice a second, slowed 15%, take 20% more damage and are crit with +8% chance (half for other classes); you regenerate 2% life a second on it.

skills.Name: Holy Charge
skills.Description: Charge behind your shield and stun the first enemy in your path. The ground where you stop is hallowed for 2 seconds: enemies on it are hurt and slowed 15%; you regenerate 2% life a second on it.

skills.Name: Pyre of Faith
skills.Description: Light a pyre of holy fire around you: enemies inside burn for damage that grows with your maximum life. It burns you up to 6% life a second (your Fire resistance lowers it); press again to put it out.

skills.Name: Hallowed Slam
skills.Description: Slam the ground in front of you and hallow it for 3 seconds: enemies on it are hurt twice a second and take 8% more damage (half for other classes); you regenerate 1% life a second on it.

skills.Name: Shield Throw
skills.Description: Hurl your shield at the enemy in front of you. It rings off the first enemy into the next, a little weaker at every leap.

skills.Name: Quick Shot
skills.Description: Loose an arrow at the target. Free to use.

skills.Name: Piercing Shot
skills.Description: Draw the bow to its full and loose a heavy arrow that pierces every enemy in its path.

skills.Name: Split Shot
skills.Description: Loose a fan of {Projectiles} arrows. Each enemy is struck by one arrow. One more arrow at gem levels 8 and 16.

skills.Name: Rain of Arrows
skills.Description: Fire a volley into the sky that rains down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times.

skills.Name: Wind Vault
skills.Description: Vault on a gust of wind, shoving nearby enemies away on landing and loosing three arrows at the nearest. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.

skills.Name: Lightning Arrow
skills.Description: Loose an arrow charged with lightning. When it strikes, lightning leaps to more enemies, a little weaker on each jump.

skills.Name: Ballista
skills.Description: Plant a ballista that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds.

skills.Name: Caustic Arrow
skills.Description: Loose a rotten arrow that bursts into a caustic cloud where it strikes, poisoning every enemy inside.

skills.Name: Fuse Arrow
skills.Description: Loose an arrow with a burning fuse. It bursts in fire where it strikes, hitting every enemy around the target.

skills.Name: Hoarfrost Volley
skills.Description: Loose a close cone of frost arrows that chill what they hit.

skills.Name: Twin Cuts
skills.Description: Your blades' basic attack, no mana cost. A quick cut with each blade at the enemy in front of you.

skills.Name: Flurry
skills.Description: A storm of five quick cuts in front of you; the last is a heavy finisher that throws enemies back.

skills.Name: Iaido Thrust
skills.Description: Dash through enemies toward the cursor, cutting everything on your line and marking them. Sheathe later bursts the marks. You cannot be hit for the first 0.2 seconds.

skills.Name: Crescent Slash
skills.Description: A heavy cross cut with both blades. The cut flies on as a crescent wave that slices through every enemy on its line.

skills.Name: Shuriken Fan
skills.Description: Flick a fan of spinning shuriken at the enemy. Each one cuts through several foes before it stops.

skills.Name: Blade Vortex
skills.Description: Spectral blades join a ring that circles you, sweeping out into the pack and back, cutting every enemy they pass. Every basic attack that lands adds a blade.

skills.Name: Thousand Cuts
skills.Description: Become a blur of steel: fly from group to group five times, cutting everything near each one. You cannot be hit while you fly.

skills.Name: Sheathe
skills.Description: Sheathe your blades with a click: every enemy Iaido Thrust has marked bursts apart, nearest first. Cut enemies with Iaido Thrust first.

skills.Name: Viper Fang
skills.Description: Three quick poisoned stabs at the enemy in front of you. Every stab lays a stack of poison that keeps eating at the enemy.

skills.Name: Moonfall
skills.Description: Leap to the cursor and fall on the enemies there with both blades. As you sheathe them, every enemy you struck is cut again for half the damage.

skills.Name: Cyclone
skills.Description: Hold to spin with your weapon outstretched, moving toward the cursor through enemies and cutting everything around you. Costs mana while you spin.

skills.Name: Shield Charge
skills.Description: Charge toward the cursor behind your shield, ploughing through every enemy in your way, and burst on arrival. Each enemy the blast catches gives back mana.

skills.Name: Earthshatter
skills.Description: Slam the ground so hard it splits: a fissure tears toward the cursor. Enemies it kills leave a rock spike that shatters a moment later.

skills.Name: Rending Slam
skills.Description: Bring a two-handed weapon down so hard the ground rends: a shockwave runs out toward the cursor, hitting every enemy on its line. A share of your maximum life joins the base damage.

skills.Name: Wheeling Axe
skills.Description: Hurl a spinning axe toward the cursor. It cuts through every enemy in its path, then wheels back and cuts them again.

supports.Name: Chain
supports.Description: Chains 2 additional times, each time to another enemy (never the same one twice): strong in packs, adds nothing against a lone boss. Each jump hits 8% harder than the last. 5% less damage.

supports.Name: Multiple Projectiles
supports.Description: Fires 2 additional projectiles in a fan. 15% less damage. Each enemy is hit by one projectile per cast; the extras hit the pack behind.

supports.Name: Increased Area
supports.Description: 65% increased area of effect (radius about 28% larger).

supports.Name: Concentrated Effect
supports.Description: 30% less area of effect. 12% more damage and 25% increased damage.

supports.Name: Added Lightning
supports.Description: Adds 1 to 6 lightning damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage, and +10% chance to Shock.

supports.Name: Added Poison
supports.Description: Adds 1 to 6 poison damage, scaled by gem level. Penetrates 10% poison resistance. -40% to Damage over Time Multiplier. Any hit with poison damage can poison; minions at half strength.

supports.Name: Added Fire
supports.Description: Spells gain 2 to 5 fire damage, scaled by gem level. Every skill gains 30% of its physical damage (after conversion) as extra fire damage.

supports.Name: Elemental Focus
supports.Description: 12% more and 25% increased Fire, Cold and Lightning damage, but the skill's Ignites deal 40% less damage. Physical and Poison gain nothing. Conversion comes first: Physical converted to an element gains it.

supports.Name: Toxic Focus
supports.Description: 12% more poison damage and 25% increased poison damage: poison hits and the poisons they apply. Damage converted to Poison (Venom) counts as poison too.

supports.Name: Faster Casting
supports.Description: 25% more cast speed. On a summon of casters (Skeletal Mage): they cast 25% faster.

supports.Name: Faster Attacks
supports.Description: 25% more attack speed. On a summon: its minions attack 25% faster.

supports.Name: Elemental Penetration
supports.Description: Hits ignore 20% of enemy elemental resistance.

supports.Name: Life Leech
supports.Description: 1.5% of the damage the skill deals is leeched as life, and its hits deal 15% more damage while you are leeching (below full life); its Bleed, Poison and Ignite do not.

supports.Name: Brutality
supports.Description: 22% more physical damage and 125% increased Physical Attack damage (minions: 10% increased physical damage). Deals no elemental damage: converted shares are lost. Heralds of Embers, Rime and Storms add nothing; Herald of Rot still does.

supports.Name: Pierce
supports.Description: Projectiles pierce 2 additional targets. 10% less damage.

supports.Name: Spell Echo
supports.Description: The spell repeats once. 15% less damage. 10% less cast speed. An echoed curse is 20% stronger. On a Spark skill it adds one more striking Spark instead of a repeat. Never repeats a dash, a Vow, a toggle or a triggered spell. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

supports.Name: Melee Physical Damage
supports.Description: 12% more melee physical damage and 75% increased Physical Attack damage (minions: 10% increased physical damage). 10% less attack speed. Works on melee minions. It scales only the physical left after conversion.

supports.Name: Controlled Destruction
supports.Description: 15% more spell damage and 30% increased spell damage. -40% to Critical Strike Multiplier: best on spells that rarely crit.

supports.Name: Bloodbound
supports.Description: The skill costs life instead of mana (10% more cost) and deals 7% more damage, another 10% more on hits below half life. Keeps a channel running on an empty mana pool.

supports.Name: Siphon
supports.Description: 2% of the linked skill's damage is leeched as life; attacks also leech 1% as mana. A totem's hits leech at 30% of that.

supports.Name: Tithe
supports.Description: Each hit of the linked skill returns 2 mana plus 0.4% of your maximum mana (attacks); each kill returns 6 plus 2% (spells, attacks, a linked summon's minions). On a Guardian or Unique enemy, each 4% of its life lost returns the kill mana.

supports.Name: Woebringer
supports.Description: The linked Woe becomes an aura: it reserves 24% of your mana and lays the Woe on every enemy within 4.5 m (area size adds). Each linked Woe is its own aura, up to the Woes an enemy can carry (2 + extra Woes). Press again to end.

supports.Name: Pass Sentence
supports.Description: When the Sentenced enemy dies, the Sentence passes to the nearest rare or unique enemy (else the nearest enemy) within 10 metres.

supports.Name: Gather Fury
supports.Description: Kills with the linked skill grant a Fury charge (once per 0.5 s): 8% increased damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed each, 5 at most. Minion kills: half grant it. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, each 4% of its life lost counts as a kill.

supports.Name: Bloodlust
supports.Description: Melee skills only. Each kill grants 1 Bloodlust stack: 1% increased melee damage, 0.2% increased melee attack speed and 0.1% increased movement speed each, up to 50, 5 s each. Minion kills: half grant it.

supports.Name: War Banner
supports.Description: Retired: the War Banner is now a skill gem of its own. Any War Banner support you had became the War Banner skill gem.

supports.Name: Hunter's Mark
supports.Description: Bow, Projectile and minion skills. Each hit puts 1 Hunter's Mark on the enemy: 1.7% more damage taken per Mark, up to 10. Marks fall off 3 s after your last hit. Adds with curses and every other takes-more-damage effect. Minions: half strength. At full Marks, hits from skills without this support deal 15% more.

supports.Name: Unravel
supports.Description: Spell skills only. Each hit adds 1 Unravel stack for the hit's element: the enemy takes 0.7% more damage of that element per stack, up to 25 (17.5%). Stacks last 4 seconds after your last hit.

supports.Name: Woe Bearer
supports.Description: The linked Woe is borne by your blows: every enemy your hits and your totems' hits strike takes it too, while it has room (it never replaces one). Not minion hits or triggered spells. Two Woe Bearers work at once, +1 per extra Woe.

supports.Name: Spell Totem
supports.Description: Casting places a totem (1 at a time, 8 seconds) that casts the spell at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds, whatever your cast speed. 35% less damage. Works on Projectile, Chain, Nova and Skyfall spells. Bow skills use Arrow Totem. A Totem's Judgement strikes for 60% of your own cast.

supports.Name: Arrow Totem
supports.Description: Firing places a totem (1 at a time, 8 seconds) that fires the bow skill at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds instead of you. 60% less damage. Only for bow skills that shoot arrows. Multiple Totems adds totems.

supports.Name: Multiple Totems
supports.Description: You may have 1 more totem or ballista of this skill, and it recovers 20% faster. 20% less damage. At most 7 bow engines and 11 spell totems in all. Totems and Ballistas of one skill share their damage: each past the first adds 50% of one's damage.

supports.Name: Bone Guard
supports.Description: Minions have 20% more life, 50% more armour and regenerate 2.5% life per second. While one is within 9 m, you have 30% more armour plus 10 per level, and regenerate 1% life per second.

supports.Name: Ravening Host
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill range ahead of you and hunt, engaging enemies 50% farther away. They deal 9% more damage and 25% increased damage and move, attack and cast 15% faster.

supports.Name: Lightning
supports.Description: Converts 60% of Physical, Fire and Cold damage to Lightning (Poison 30%). Hits shock with 30% increased effect of Shock, and 1 more Shock can stack on an enemy. A spinning attack calls lightning down onto the enemies it cuts. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

supports.Name: Flame
supports.Description: 60% of Physical, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Fire (Poison at half: 30%). Hits ignite. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

supports.Name: Ice
supports.Description: 60% of Physical, Fire and Lightning damage is converted to Cold (Poison at half: 30%). Hits chill; chilled kills shatter. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

supports.Name: Venom
supports.Description: 30% of Physical, Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Poison. +25% chance to Poison. Poison hits ignore 15% of Poison resistance. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 70% left physical.

supports.Name: Skyfall
supports.Description: The skill falls on its target from above instead of travelling. Works on Projectile, Chain, Spark and Nova spells, projectile attacks and the Ballista volley. Each enemy is struck once per use. Extra projectiles merge into one bigger strike. 20% less damage.

supports.Name: Tether
supports.Description: Each enemy hit is linked to up to 2 others within 5 m for 3 s (6 links at most); linked enemies take 15% of the hit's damage per second. With Orbit, Rain or Skyfall, the earlier socket shapes the skill. No links with Trap or a Totem gem.

supports.Name: Swift Step
supports.Description: The movement skill has a 40% shorter cooldown and deals 8% more damage and 15% increased damage.

supports.Name: Channel Conduit
supports.Description: While you channel, the spell dropped on this gem casts itself at the nearest enemy every 0.5 s for half its mana cost. 30% more channelling cost. The spell must be on your skill bar, is never a totem or trap, and triggers nothing.

supports.Name: Honed Edge
supports.Description: +1% to base Critical Strike Chance and 80% increased Critical Strike Chance. Best on a build that already raises its critical strikes. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Deathblow
supports.Description: +50% to Critical Strike Multiplier: critical strikes hit much harder. Best with Honed Edge or other critical strike chance. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Orbit
supports.Description: Projectiles circle you for 1.5 seconds, then each flies at the nearest enemy. Spells gain +1 projectile; attacks deal 50% less damage. Up to 24 circle at once. A projectile sent at an enemy already struck this cast deals 90% less damage (attacks 97% less).

supports.Name: Unbroken Channel
supports.Description: Up to 25% more damage, ramping in over the first second of channelling. 20% less channelling cost.

supports.Name: Minion Damage
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill deal 12% more damage and 25% increased damage.

supports.Name: Minion Life
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill have 25% more life and 175% increased life.

supports.Name: Minion Speed
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill move, attack and cast 25% faster.

supports.Name: Fork
supports.Description: Projectiles fork in two on hitting an enemy, each dealing 70% of the hit. A piercing projectile forks once its pierce runs out. Shuriken Fan, melee waves and Ballista bolts fork at their first enemy.

supports.Name: Rain
supports.Description: The projectiles go up and rain down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times (four times with 4 or more projectiles). 50% less damage. A Ballista's bolts rain down twice.

supports.Name: Trap
supports.Description: The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds) that goes off when an enemy comes within 4 metres, then re-arms after about a second. Each Trap strikes for its own hit: 50% less damage and 25% increased damage per strike; its first strike deals 15% more. Traps set off other Traps nearby.

supports.Name: Afterimage
supports.Description: Supported melee attacks are repeated once by a ghost of the swing. 20% less damage. Multi-blow skills repeat every blow. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

supports.Name: Affliction
supports.Description: +35% chance to Ignite and +35% chance to Poison. 50% increased Burning and Poison damage. 10% less damage with hits.

supports.Name: Stormfrost
supports.Description: +25% chance to Shock and 50% increased effect of Shock. Cold hits build up Freeze 60% faster, and its Lightning damage is 15% more against Chilled or Frozen enemies.

supports.Name: Repeat
supports.Description: Bow skills fire 1 more time, a moment later (a Ballista fires each bolt twice). Channelled skills strike 1 more time inside each pulse. 45% less damage. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

supports.Name: Cast on Crit
supports.Description: Your critical hits trigger this skill. A linked spell casts on your skill's crits; an unlinked spell casts itself (one cast per 0.3 seconds); an unlinked attack strikes again on another attack's crit (one strike per 0.75 seconds, 58% less damage in all). All your Cast on Crit share one 0.15 second clock. Triggered skills pay their full mana cost, deal 25% less damage, must be on your skill bar and never spend your last 20% of mana. Movement, channelled, summon, totem and aura skills are never triggered, and a totem's hits never trigger it.

supports.Name: Cast when Hit
supports.Description: Each time you take damage equal to 10% of your maximum life, a spell casts at the attacker. Drop a spell on this skill's link to cast that one; with no link, a spell skill casts itself, so no second spell is needed. Once per 0.5 seconds, 50% of its mana cost, never your last 20% of mana. It deals 10% less damage. One link per skill. Movement, channelled, summon, totem and aura skills are never triggered.

supports.Name: Cast on Minion Death
supports.Description: When a minion from this skill dies, the linked spell casts itself at the enemy nearest to where it fell, at most once per second, for 50% of its mana cost, never your last 20% of mana. The spell deals 10% less damage. Drop a spell on it to link it. One link per skill.

supports.Name: Rend
supports.Description: Physical hits have a 50% chance to cause Bleeding: 40% of the hit's physical damage per second for 4 s (50% more while the enemy moves). 12% more and 100% increased Bleeding damage. Slams and crits cash 50% of the next 4 s at once. Minion skills at half strength.

supports.Name: Deep Wounds
supports.Description: +40% to Damage over Time Multiplier for this skill: its Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal more. Hits are unchanged. Slams and crits cash 50% of the next 4 s of bleed at once. Minion skills at half strength.

supports.Name: Gathering Storm
supports.Description: Shocks from this skill stack: 2 more Shocks on an enemy (3 in all), up to 75% more damage taken. Each Shock scales with the Lightning in its hit. +25% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. Minion skills at half strength.

supports.Name: Contagious Flame
supports.Description: When an enemy this skill ignited dies, its Ignite spreads to enemies within 4.5 m. While burning, it also passes its Ignite each second to the nearest enemy within 3 m. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. Minion skills at half strength.

supports.Name: Shatter
supports.Description: Chilled or Frozen enemies this skill kills shatter: 12% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 m, chilling them; an enemy the burst kills shatters in turn. 20% increased effect of Chill. Minions: half strength.

supports.Name: Melee Splash
supports.Description: Every blow splashes: enemies within 2 metres of each enemy struck take 55% of the blow's damage (once per blow). 10% less damage. Works on minions: their blows splash too.

supports.Name: Multistrike
supports.Description: The melee attack strikes 3 times: it repeats 2 more times, and every strike deals 44% of the damage (56% less). Multi-blow skills repeat every blow. On a minion skill, each of its blows strikes 2 more times. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

supports.Name: Maim
supports.Description: Hits Maim the enemy for 4 s: it moves 30% slower and takes 10% more Physical damage from hits by you, your minions and your allies (not Bleed). 8% more Physical damage. Only Physical counts: converted damage gains nothing.

supports.Name: Ruthless
supports.Description: Every third blow is a Ruthless blow: 60% more Physical damage on that hit (the Bleed or Poison it starts is not raised) and a heavy, bloody impact. Works on minions: every third blow of each minion.

supports.Name: Executioner
supports.Description: 35% more damage to enemies below half life on the physical part of a hit (14% on fire, cold, lightning, poison); hits kill enemies left below 10% life (Guardians too). Hits only, not Bleed, Poison or Ignite. Works with bows and minions.

supports.Name: Vicious Projectiles
supports.Description: 12% more Physical damage with projectiles and 100% increased Physical damage with projectile attacks, 10% less attack speed. Only the Physical part counts, so a conversion support takes it away. Minions that shoot at half strength.

supports.Name: Added Cold
supports.Description: Adds 3 to 4 cold damage to spells and attacks, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. Steadier than Added Lightning (1 to 6) for the same average: it chills where Added Lightning shocks.

supports.Name: Chain Detonation
supports.Description: Supports Traps. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby in a chain, at 100% increased distance. Each Trap further down the chain deals 8% more damage. +1 maximum Traps.

supports.Name: Volatile Dead
supports.Description: Minions explode where they fall: killed, expired, or replaced past your limit. Each blast deals Fire damage in 3 m equal to 80% of its hit damage. Recast at your limit to detonate your oldest minions.

supports.Name: Funeral Pyre
supports.Description: Enemies killed by the skill's hits burst into flame, dealing Fire damage in 2.5 m equal to 15% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 200 at most, bosses 150), grown by the skill's increased and more damage. The burst is not a hit, so it never chains.

supports.Name: Inspiration
supports.Description: The linked skill costs 25% less. No damage of its own: it keeps a spammed spell or attack firing.

supports.Name: Economical Vow
supports.Description: The linked Vow or Herald reserves 10% less of your pool, multiplied with the 20% less every Vow and Herald already has: 28% less in all.

supports.Name: Wide Burst
supports.Description: The linked Herald's kill effect reaches 60% further: Embers and Rot burst over 4 metres, Rime shatters over 4.8 metres, Storms arcs to enemies within 8 metres. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.

supports.Name: Ruinous Herald
supports.Description: The linked Herald's kill effect deals 60% more damage (Embers 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life becomes 19.2%). Kills that chain into kills: a clear speed pick. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.

supports.Name: Lingering Woe
supports.Description: The linked Woe builds Dread 50% faster and lasts 50% longer on every enemy it touches (cast, channelled, borne by Woe Bearer or sworn with Woebringer).

supports.Name: Dawnbringer
supports.Description: Every third hit of the linked Holy attack calls a pillar of dawn, dealing 240% of the hit as Fire damage. For Holy Slash, Hallowed Slam, Holy Charge and Shield Throw.

supports.Name: Grave Conscription
supports.Description: Enemies killed by the linked attack have a 25% chance to rise as your Zombie while you have fewer than 4 (once per 0.5 s). Your minion damage and life apply to them.

supports.Name: Venom Bloom
supports.Description: Every fourth hit of the linked Poison attack bursts in venom (once per 0.2 s): enemies within 2.5 m take 45% of the hit as Poison damage, each enemy at most once every 0.5 seconds. For Gravereap, Soul Rend and Marrow Lance.

supports.Name: Sanctifying Light
supports.Description: Holy attacks: 60% of Fire, Cold and Lightning damage converts to Physical (Poison 30%), so added elemental damage feeds your Physical bonuses. 8% more Physical damage and 15% increased Physical damage. Pairs with Brutality.

supports.Name: Whirling Host
supports.Description: The linked Orbit skill adds one more blade or hammer per cast and its ring holds one more (Blade Vortex 9, Orbiting Hammers 4), each dealing 15% less damage.

supports.Name: Conjured Pair
supports.Description: The linked Orb skill keeps one more orb at a time (Winter Orb: two orbs by your shoulders, both formed by one cast), each dealing 35% less damage. Twice the icicles over twice the ground: more coverage, a little more damage in all.

supports.Name: Rampart Strike
supports.Description: The linked Shield attack deals 0.3% more damage per 1% chance to block you have (50% block: 15% more). For Shield Charge, Holy Charge and Shield Throw.

supports.Name: Deepened Woe
supports.Description: Every line of the linked Woe is 21% stronger: the damage it makes enemies take, the resistance it lowers, the damage they deal less and its slow. The Woe's own build, for when one Woe carries the whole party.

supports.Name: Tempered Aura
supports.Description: The linked damaging aura gnaws 40% less of your life (Unholy Void 0.9% to 0.54% a second, Pyre of Faith 6% to 3.6%). Stand in the fire longer: the support for life stacking aura builds.

supports.Name: Spreading Pyre
supports.Description: The linked corpse skill's fire leaps to 3 more fresh corpses, each within the burst's radius of the last, bursting at 70% of the one before. Pyre Burst at gem 20: 10%, 7%, 4.9%, 3.4% of the slain's life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life), counted at Rupture Level 200 at most (bosses 150), without pack bonus life. Corpses its fire makes carry it on.

supports.Name: Defiant Roar
supports.Description: The linked war cry also grants a Fury charge for each Resolve charge, and Resolve lasts 50% longer (10 s to 15 s). Fury: 8% increased damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed each, 5 charges at most.

supports.Name: Rallying Standard
supports.Description: The linked War Banner lands with 5 Valour, keeps all of its Valour when moved (not half), and holds 10 more (30). Each Valour is 0.5% more damage taken by enemies near it.

supports.Name: Focused Volley
supports.Description: The linked bow skill fires 1 more arrow, and all its arrows fly on one line at your target. Each arrow after the first deals 35% of the one before it. 15% less damage. A Guardian killer: you give up the spread.

supports.Name: Killer Instinct
supports.Description: Linked minions gain +2% base critical strike chance, 100% increased critical strike chance and +20% to critical strike multiplier.

supports.Name: Ironclad Fury
supports.Description: The linked skill deals 0.25% more damage per 1,000 Armour you have (40,000 Armour: 10% more). Any attack or spell, totems and traps too.

supports.Name: Kindling
supports.Description: Spells only. Each kill with the linked spell grants 1 stack of Kindling: 0.5% increased spell damage and 0.2% increased cast speed per stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds.

supports.Name: Fervent Vow
supports.Description: Every line of the linked Vow gets another 15% of its base value while sworn, its Vowbreak too (Vow of Iron at gem level 20: 50.6% to 57.2% more Armour). Heralds grow with Herald Effect.

supports.Name: Arc Conduit
supports.Description: When this skill hits a Shocked enemy, lightning arcs to the 2 nearest other Shocked enemies within 8 m for 40% of the hit (twice per second per enemy, no re-arcing). +20% chance to Shock with Lightning hits.

supports.Name: Frostbreak
supports.Description: Hits deal 50% more damage to a Brittle Guardian or boss (5.5 s after its freeze bar fills). Hits on a Chilled or Frozen enemy shed shards: 25% of the hit as Cold damage to up to 6 enemies within 3 m (twice a second per enemy).

supports.Name: Wildfire
supports.Description: When this skill hits a Burning enemy, flames leap to the 2 nearest enemies within 5 m that are not burning: each takes 30% of the hit as Fire damage and is always Ignited (twice a second per enemy). +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits.

supports.Name: Haemorrhage
supports.Description: Hits of this skill deal 15% more damage to an enemy Bleeding from another of your skills (its own bleed does not count). Open with a bleed, then tear it with this.

supports.Name: Lone Herald
supports.Description: The linked Herald's extra damage and kill effect are 15% stronger for each other Herald you have not sworn. Alone it is 60% stronger. With every Herald sworn it adds nothing. The reservation the other Heralds would take is yours to spend.

supports.Name: Woeweaver
supports.Description: Hits of this skill deal 25% more damage to an enemy bearing exactly one Woe, 10% more with two, none more with three or more.

supports.Name: Quarry Command
supports.Description: Linked minions hunt your quarry: the last enemy you hit yourself in 6 s, within 15 m. They deal 30% more damage to it and 30% less to every other enemy while you have a quarry.

supports.Name: Skyward Oath
supports.Description: Critical strikes of the linked Melee attack call down 2 Sky Swords on the enemy, each dealing 24% of that critical hit (once a second), within 2.5 m. They are not hits of the attack and trigger nothing.

supports.Name: Stormhound Pact
supports.Description: Critical strikes of the linked Lightning spell loose a Storm Wolf for 4 seconds (once a second, at most 2 wolves). Each wolf leaps at an enemy within 8 metres every 0.8 seconds for 16% of that critical hit as Lightning damage.

supports.Name: Pale Apprentices
supports.Description: Enemies the linked spell kills have a 20% chance to rise as one of your Skeletal Mages (up to 3 this way, once per 0.5 s). Your minion damage and life apply; so do the minion supports of Summon Skeletal Mage.

supports.Name: Rimewake
supports.Description: The linked Movement skill ends in a frost burst: enemies within 3 m of the target take 25% of the hit as Cold damage (once per 0.5 s), and your Chill has 20% increased effect with it. Arrive, and the pack is cold for Shatter.

supports.Name: Gravesown
supports.Description: While you channel the skill, a Husk claws up within 3 m every 0.6 to 0.8 s (at most 3). Otherwise 10% chance per enemy hit to leave one. A Husk is a fresh corpse for 6 s, with no experience or loot.

supports.Name: Kindled Remains
supports.Description: Each pulse or hit sets off up to 3 fresh corpses within 2.5 m at once (at most 4 corpses a second). Each bursts in 2 m as the skill's damage type for a share of the corpse's life (12.6% below Rupture Level 50, 25.2% at 50-99, 28.8% from 100), grown by the skill's increased and more damage. Cannot crit.

supports.Name: Chaos
supports.Description: 40% of this skill's hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy. It implodes 3 s later as Chaos damage (10% more), ignoring Armour and elemental Resistance. A dying enemy bursts 30% of its Entropy onto enemies within 3 m. No Ailments or Leech. Not for minion skills.

supports.Name: Entropic Focus
supports.Description: Entropy this skill lays implodes for 22% more damage.

supports.Name: Hastened Ruin
supports.Description: Entropy this skill starts on an enemy implodes after 1.5 seconds instead of 3. Entropy this skill lays implodes for 10% less damage. Quiet Ruin has no timer to shorten.

supports.Name: Gathering Dark
supports.Description: Entropy this skill starts on an enemy implodes after 6 seconds instead of 3. Entropy this skill lays implodes for 10% more damage. Sheathe, Iaido Thrust and Grave Debt still implode it early.

supports.Name: Cascading Ruin
supports.Description: When an enemy dies owing this skill's Entropy, 60% of it is laid on each enemy within 3 metres instead of bursting. If one of them dies owing it, it bursts for 30% and stops. Does nothing against a lone enemy.

supports.Name: Pact of Ruin
supports.Description: This skill costs life instead of mana (30% more cost). A further 15% of its hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Entropy this skill lays implodes for 6% more damage.
